Job Summary

Job Title Senior LLM Engineer Agentic AI MultiAgent Systems Position Summary The LLM Engineer will be responsible for designing building and optimizing enterprisegrade AI agents that power the 7Eleven Store Assistant and Equipment Maintenance solutions The role focuses on LLM integration prompt engineering agent orchestration RAG pipelines memory management tool calling and AI governance to enable reliable and scalable Agentic AI capabilities

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop Agentic AI solutions including orchestrator agents intent routers memory components AI skills tool integrations and multiagent workflows
Build and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation RAG pipelines using vector databases semantic search knowledge retrieval and enterprise content repositories
Develop prompts reasoning frameworks guardrails and agent instructions to improve response quality task completion accuracy and business relevance
Integrate AI agents with enterprise platforms including Oracle ERP ServiceNow MCP servers APIs business workflows and operational tools
Implement AI observability tracing evaluation frameworks hallucination mitigation and performance monitoring for production AI systems
Collaborate with Product Managers Data Engineers Business SMEs and AI Architects to continuously improve agent effectiveness and business outcomes
